description: A React component for onboarding users to customize and generate a personalized learning path, including goal setting, skill selection, and analysis.

classes.name: LearningPathOnboardingProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining props for the LearningPathOnboarding component.

methods.name: toggleSkill
methods.description: Toggles the selection of a skill in the user's skill list.

methods.name: addCustomSkill
methods.description: Adds a custom skill to the selected skills list after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: handleAnalyze
methods.description: Performs analysis of the user's goal and skills, updates profile, enrolls in path, and handles errors.
